messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Observability bridge error for tenant=acadia-prod — traces/spans dropped for requests routed via vpc-forwarder-08 starting ~2026-03-15T07:10Z. No trace ingestion seen. Paging oncall.
sam (oncall-sre): I see the alert. taking ownership, marking P0. pinging @pete for forwarder/network side.
maria (eng-platform): FYI this forwarder was bumped to 1.4.2 yesterday, there were some rate-limit patches. could be related.
leah (cs-acadia): Acadia on-call cs confirmed: they noticed missing trace links in their dev portal and a handful of customer-reported slow ops. They say logs for the tenant are present, but traces are empty. very noisy for a single customer.
ingrid (oncall-rotation): copying runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/obs-bridge-forwarder. steps: check forwarder health, verify kafka/ingest ack, check tenant routing table.
sam (oncall-sre): running quick checks — connecting to forwarder pod for vpc-forwarder-08
sam (oncall-sre): ```
kubectl -n redwood-forwarders exec -it pod/vpc-forwarder-08 -- sh -c "tail -n200 /var/log/forwarder/forwarder.log | grep acadia-prod | tail -n50"
```
sam (oncall-sre): log shows a lot of `403 Tenant write denied` entries starting at 07:12Z. looks like ACL mismatch when forwarder attempted to publish spans.
pete (netops): that suggests the forwarder lost the tenant delegation token or the forwarder role was rotated. checking secrets and the envoy route ACLs now.
pete (netops): quick mitigation: I've enabled the fallback-forwarder route for acadia-prod (route -> vpc-forwarder-fallback) so traffic will bypass the bridge for spans only. should restore traces but may add 50-100ms.
leah (cs-acadia): Please confirm asap so we can message Acadia support. They asked for ETA on restoration.
maria (eng-platform): I pushed a hotfix to forwarder reconciler to refresh delegation tokens on restart; rolling to v1.4.3 patch. rollout started to forwarder-08 and fallback.
deploy-bot: deploy: started rollout redwood/forwarder v1.4.3 -> v1.4.3-patch (pods: vpc-forwarder-08) (link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/forwarder/2419876543)
sam (oncall-sre): after enabling fallback route, I'm seeing traces reappear for sample traces. can @leah confirm on Acadia's side?
leah (cs-acadia): confirmed from Acadia: traces are showing up again in their portal for recent requests. they still see a ~10% drop for the window 07:10-07:46; want a postmortem.
ingrid (oncall-rotation): capture scope: root cause = forwarder rejected tenant writes due to rotated role/token; mitigation = fallback route + token refresh hotfix; customer impact window and affected p95s logged. assigning postmortem to eng-platform + netops.
maria (eng-platform): I'll take postmortem. initial action items: add stronger token rotation alert, add ACL regression test to forwarder CI, add tenant-level replay check to runbook.
sam (oncall-sre): updating incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2419876543. tagging cs and account team. I'll drop a brief customer-facing blurb for @leah to send.
leah (cs-acadia): thanks. draft ack for Acadia: "We've restored trace ingestion. We observed a transient 36-minute window where traces for tenant acadia-prod were dropped due to a delegation token ACL mismatch. We routed spans to a fallback forwarder and deployed a patch. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem." sending now.
sam (oncall-sre): final: leave fallback route in place until next maintenance window; patch in prod; postmortem ETA 48h. closing paging unless anything else.
leah (cs-acadia): closing with :white_check_mark:. Acadia is satisfied with the immediate fix and requests follow-up meeting next week.
